jobs.title: Cleanroom Environmental Monitoring Technicians
jobs.description:
**Overview**  
We are seeking a highly motivated Cleanroom Environmental Monitoring Technicians to join our team in PAL's Microbiology \& EM services for Biotech, Pharma, medical device, and Compounding Pharmacies companies. The positions are temporary with potential for becoming regular employee later on. This role is essential in ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining the integrity of our laboratory processes. Services include validation of clean rooms, water systems and compressed gases systems, and routine sampling of these systems. EM techs must follow proper safety practices and comply with GMP requirements as needed and with client requirements. We are looking for a person willing to work hard, able to work overtime, start work early and sometimes weekends.

**Responsibilities**

* Perform in\-house and field environmental monitoring sampling at client facilities (cleanrooms, water systems and compressed gases systems).
* Perform water testing such as bioburden, TOC, endotoxin and conductivity.

Requirements

* Minimum AS degree in science with a concentration in microbiology. The position requires at least 1 year of hands\-on experience in microbiology or EM testing in an FDA GMP regulated.
* Hands on experience in endotoxin testing, cleanroom Environmental monitoring, water testing and USP microbial methods.
* Experience performing USP, FDA BAM, AOAC, and ISO microbiology test procedures for biotech, pharmaceutical, and other FDA regulated products.
* Excellent organizational skills along with good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to follow instructions and work as a team member.
* Valid driver’s license required.
* Ability to start early (6am), work overtime and weekends as needed to complete projects.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to gown into a coverall and work in a cleanroom environment for long hours.
* Ability to stand and be on your feet for long hours.
* Understands, reads and comprehends English fluently.
* Ability to lift and move 20 pounds.
* Legal to work in the USA.
* Must pass background check and drug testing.

Pay: $25\.20 \- $30\.35 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking an **Environmental Scientist II** to join our Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) team.**We are seeking candidates to fill a seconded role as an on\-site Health \& Safety Specialist for a program in Rancho Cordova, California**. This full\-time position within our Environmental group will provide and coordinate support related to Health \& Safety and Environmental Compliance in a research and development laboratory and office setting. The duration of this position will be contingent upon AECOM maintaining our contract with the client.

**Job Summary/Responsibilities:**

* Manage and support health, safety and environmental projects and programs, including planning, coordination, execution, and tracking of deliverables to ensure compliance and timely completion.
* Conduct on‑site inspections to evaluate compliance with federal, state, and local environmental regulations (e.g., air, water, waste, hazardous materials).
* Review permits, plans, records, and monitoring data to verify adherence to regulatory requirements and permit conditions.
* Identify violations, non‑conformances, and environmental risks; document findings through clear, detailed inspection reports.
* Investigate citizen complaints, spill reports, or alleged violations and determine appropriate enforcement or corrective actions.
* Communicate findings and compliance requirements to facility representatives; provide technical guidance on corrective measures and best practices.
* Coordinate with regulatory agencies and internal stakeholders to support enforcement actions, follow‑up inspections, or compliance reviews.
* Maintain inspection records, databases, and tracking systems to ensure accurate documentation and timely reporting.
* Interpret and apply relevant regulations (e.g., Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, RCRA, EPCRA) to inspection activities and compliance determinations.
* Participate in compliance assistance outreach, training sessions, or stakeholder meetings to promote environmental stewardship and regulatory awareness.
* Interprets and records data, conducts analyses, compares findings to relevant studies and local, state and federal regulations to ensure compliance. Work is performed with minimal direction.
* Performing complex assignments often requires the development of unique solutions to problems.
* Participating in internal and client required calls.

**About AECOM’s Environment Business Line**  

Join AECOM to be part of an expert global team who is connected through a well\-developed, worldwide, internal technical practice network through which you can learn from and brainstorm with the best in the world. AECOM is an industry\-leading, world class environmental firm, and we want you to succeed within it. We respect and encourage your own pathway to excellence via our Freedom to Grow initiative.  

  

AECOM is known for our award\-winning technical excellence, leading\-edge science and innovative project delivery. We provide sustainable solutions for some of the world’s most challenging issues. Our global clients and their projects span a variety of market sectors and geographies and require innovative technical solutions to solve wide\-ranging environmental problems.

 **Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements:**

* BA/BS in related sciences.
* 2 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education in supporting environmental projects related to health and safety and environmental compliance.
* Valid U.S. Driver's license is required for this role.
* Due to the nature of work, US citizenship is required.
* Candidate must be able to meet medical clearance requirements of an OSHA (HAZWOPER) medical surveillance physical exam.

**Preferred Qualification**

* 4\+ years of relevant experience working on environmental projects related to health and safety and environmental compliance in California.
* Previous experience with research and development laboratories.
* Previous experience working as an environmental consultant.
* OSHA 40\-hour HAZWOPER Training with annual 8\-hour refresher.

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist/Project Manager
jobs.description:
Do you like working with different project teams in a fast\-paced environment? Are you interested in joining an organization focused on making a positive impact? If so, we'd like to talk with you about growing with us.


EnSafe is seeking a full\-time Environmental Scientist/Project Manager to join our team of professionals at our San Diego, CA, office.



This position has a requirement to work onsite, at the office, if needed relocation assistance may be offered to meet this expectation.


**What we are looking for**



An Environmental Scientist with proven experience managing environmental due diligence projects and a strong ability to translate complex findings into clear, defensible Phase I ESA reports. You'll work with clients across California and beyond, managing projects from site assessment through final reporting while gaining exposure to Phase II investigations, environmental sampling, and emerging areas such as PFAS risk evaluation.



Joining our team means immersing yourself in an environment that nurtures creativity, encourages collaboration at all levels, fosters a supportive culture, and facilitates professional development.


***Key responsibilities of this position include***


***What you will be doing:***


* Perform and manage Phase I Environmental Site Assessments in accordance with ASTM and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct site reconnaissance, historical research, regulatory database review, interviews, and other due diligence activities.
* Prepare clear, technically sound Phase I ESA reports and recommendations.
* Manage multiple Phase I ESA projects, including scope, schedule, budget, subcontractors, client communication, and deliverables.
* Provide technical and peer review of Phase I ESA reports as experience permits.
* Support Phase II environmental site investigations and other due diligence activities when warranted.
* Plan and conduct environmental sampling activities involving soil, groundwater, soil vapor, indoor air, surface water, or other environmental media.
* Prepare work plans, technical memoranda, investigation reports, and proposals.
* Communicate findings and environmental risk considerations clearly to clients and project teams.
* Coordinate work with junior staff and provide technical guidance and mentoring.
* Support environmental compliance projects based on experience and workload, which may include hazardous materials and hazardous waste management, SPCC, stormwater, wastewater, EPCRA/Tier II, or related regulatory requirements.
* Participate in business development activities, including preparation of scopes, budgets, proposals, and support for existing client relationships.
* Travel periodically to project sites throughout California and as needed, elsewhere in the United States.


***Minimum Skills and Requirements***


* Bachelor's degree in environmental science, Geology, Environmental Engineering, or a related scientific or engineering discipline.
* Approximately 6 or more years of relevant environmental consulting experience.
* Demonstrated experience preparing Phase I Environmental Site Assessments.
* Strong technical writing and report preparation skills.
* Ability to independently conduct site reconnaissance and evaluate environmental conditions.
* Working knowledge of environmental due diligence practices and applicable federal and state environmental regulations.
* Ability to manage schedules, budgets, client expectations, and multiple concurrent assignments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong critical\-thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel to support project work.
* Valid driver's license and ability to perform field activities associated with environmental site assessments.


***Preferred Qualifications***


***The following experience would be beneficial but is not required:***


* Experience managing Phase I ESA programs or providing technical/peer review.
* Qualification as an Environmental Professional under ASTM/AAI requirements.
* Phase II ESA, subsurface investigation, soil, groundwater, or vapor assessment experience.
* Environmental compliance experience, including hazardous waste, hazardous materials, SPCC, stormwater, wastewater, CERS/HMBP, or EPCRA/Tier II reporting.
* Experience supporting industrial, commercial real estate, logistics/warehouse, energy, municipal, or similar clients.
* Professional Geologist (PG), Professional Engineer (PE), or other relevant professional certification.
* Building sciences or hazardous building materials experience.
* Experience with asbestos\-containing materials, lead\-based paint, mold/microbial assessments, or related building surveys.
* California asbestos or lead certifications.
* 40\-hour HAZWOPER training.


**Why Join EnSafe?**


* **Employee\-Owned Advantage**  

EnSafe is 100% employee\-owned, with an ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) since 1997\. That means when EnSafe succeeds, you succeed too, turning company growth directly into shared rewards.
* **Commitment to Growth and Wellness**  

The company supports personalized career development, mentorship, and employee wellness initiatives such as health tracking tools.
* **Purpose‑Driven Work**  

EnSafe's mission focuses on impactful environmental, health, and safety consulting—making a real difference in communities and is backed by its long\-standing technical credibility.
* **Safety as a Value, Not Just a Service**  

Safety is deeply embedded in our culture, prioritizing employee well\-being in addition to helping clients maintain compliance. We stress that *"safety is part of everything we do."*
* **A Culture of Freedom \& Ownership**  

At EnSafe, our career philosophy is built on freedom. The freedom to take initiative, achieve your goals, and shape your own career path Employees are encouraged to pursue growth in a flexible, entrepreneurial environment.
* **Challenging, Creative Work**  

Workdays at EnSafe are anything but ordinary,

jobs.title: Security Officer Armed Patrol Risk Assessment
jobs.description:
Security Officer Armed Patrol Risk Assessment

**Overview**
------------

  

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.  

  

**Job Description**

* Preparing technical reports, environmental assessments and remediation documentation.
* Assisting with project coordination, including budgets, schedules, scope and stakeholder communication.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

AECOM's environmental practice is dedicated to helping industries, clients and governments meet their environmental responsibilities while protecting the natural environment. We provide advisory and technical services to ensure compliance, manage impacts, and reduce risks, including obtaining permits and approvals, decommissioning and restoring contaminated sites, and tackling climate change challenges and resilience. We focus on preserving habitats, water quality, stakeholder engagement and cultural resources, promoting a holistic approach to environmental impact management at every project stage.

**Everyone belongs at AECOM**


We’re committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging \- because great ideas come from diverse perspectives. AECOM is proud to be a Fortune 500 Most Admired Company , a WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality , \# Work180 Equitable Workplace Awards 2025 Winner and an AWEI Bronze Tier LGBTQ\+ Inclusive Employer .

**This role is based in Newcastle, NSW.**

**How you’ll make a difference**

* Delivery of air quality impact assessments, monitoring and management programs and related technical studies, ensuring high technical standards and timely delivery.
* Manage air quality projects from initiation to completion as part of a team of air quality professionals, including client engagement, reporting and proposal development.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across AECOM’s business lines, including a strong national and international Air Quality practice.
* Contribute to greenhouse gas and carbon accounting projects
* Supporting business development activities for the Air Quality practice along with technical profile raising activities to grow personal capabilities.

  

**Qualifications** **The qualities that help you thrive**


The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick all the boxes you could still be a perfect fit for this role. Please apply, all applications will be considered.

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Environmental Management or a related discipline with 2\+ years’ experience in air quality or environmental consulting.
* Proficiency in air quality dispersion modelling (e.g. CALPUFF, AERMOD) with experience in GRAL or WRF viewed favourably.
* Experience developing emission inventories, including the use of excel for emissions estimation calculations.
* Strong technical writing and communication skills, with experience preparing reports (e.g. Air Quality Impact Assessments, Air Quality Management Plans), proposals and engaging directly with clients.
* Familiarity with greenhouse gas or carbon accounting and air quality monitoring.
* Abilities in GIS (e.g. ArcGIS Pro, Q\-GIS) and programming (e.g. R, Python) would be viewed favourably.

  

**Additional Information** **Why you’ll love working with us**


Flexible work arrangements, including alternative start/finish times, job\-sharing and hybrid work options

* Purchase up to 6 weeks additional annual leave per year
* Swap public holidays – swap Easter or other holidays for ones that suit you better
